Meet your Realtor®

Local knowledge. Straight answers. Results you can see.

For 12 years, Hisham Chisti has helped buyers, sellers, landlords and investors across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area — from first condos and family homes to commercial spaces. Clients come back, and send their family and friends, because the process stays honest and simple: clear pricing, real market data, and a negotiator who protects your money like his own.

  • Free home evaluation & pricing strategy before you list
  • Pre-approval guidance and trusted mortgage & legal referrals
  • Strong offer strategy — including multi-offer situations
  • Updates at every step, right through to closing day

Talk to Hisham Today

How I can help

Everything you need, under one roof

Whether it's your first home or your next investment, you get one point of contact and a plan built around your goals.

Buying a Home

Neighbourhood tours, off-market awareness, honest assessments of value, and offer strategies that win without overpaying.

Selling Your Home

Pricing, preparation and marketing that attract serious buyers — including exposure to a large, engaged Facebook audience.

Commercial & Business

Retail plazas, storefronts and business sales. A recent Danforth commercial listing drew 13+ offers — exposure that creates competition.

Leasing

Landlords and tenants matched properly, with screening, paperwork and move-in handled cleanly and on time.

Investment Properties

Condos, multiplexes and pre-construction evaluated on real numbers — rent, expenses and resale — not hype.

First-Time Buyers

Step-by-step guidance in plain language: budgets, incentives, closing costs and what to expect at every stage.
